tex_content.html:
Lemma
[The regular part, as a subset of $M$]

↗ prop:regular-level-set-hypersurface ↗ def:regular-set

In the setting of Proposition 5, the image of $M_c=(f|_{\mathcal R})^{-1}(c)$ under $M_c\hookrightarrow \mathcal R\hookrightarrow M$ is exactly $f^{-1}(c)\cap \mathcal R$.

Proof

\sketch A point is in the image precisely when it lies in $\mathcal R$ and has $f$-value $c$.

□
